pgp_user.description: The User ID to use for signing and encryption operations. Corresponds to -u or +myname.

pubring.description: Path to the public keyring file. Corresponds to the undocumented +pubring option.

secring.description: Path to the secret keyring file. Corresponds to the undocumented +secring option.

batch_mode.description: Enable batch mode. This option is currently ignored/unsupported by pgpgpg but is listed in the man page.

armor.description: Enable ASCII armor for output. Corresponds to -a or +armor.

default_keyring.description: Default keyring file to operate on if not specified in the command. Corresponds to the [keyring] argument.

default_recipients.description: List of default recipient User IDs for encryption operations. Corresponds to the 'user ...' in pgpgpg -e.
